There are no visible AI artifacts such as melting, fusion, or unnatural textures. The reproductive structures (stamens/pistils) inside the flower throats are rendered with anatomical plausibility for morning glories/bindweeds. However, the image fails to adhere to the provided 'daisy' taxonomy checkpoints entirely, presenting trumpet-shaped flowers instead. While visually authentic as a photograph of blue flowers, it is taxonomically misaligned with the system's diagnostic class definition.
